title: Cha!
description: Kunentombazanyana enomkhuba wokuthi ‘Cha’. Ukusho lokhu kakhulu. Eqinisweni, ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kodwa ngelinye ilanga, uhlangabezana nombuzo omyengayo kangangokuba akanayo enye indlela ngaphandle kokuthi ‘YEBO!’ Mhlawumbe akukubi kangakho ukuthi ‘Yebo’ ekugcineni.
